supported.quote: With monthly-spend-feature on, the account page's spend summary calls `average_spend_per_item_this_month` in src/io_shop/spend_summary.py, which divides the shopper's month-to-date total by the number of purchases in the current month and has no case for when there are none.

so the call raises ZeroDivisionError at src/io_shop/spend_summary.py:47, and `serve_account_page` catches it and returns a failed page. It rests on F1, a reading of the source nothing ran, so it is unverified.

Switching on a new monthly-spending feature for the shop's account pages ran a calculation that fails when a shopper has no purchases in the current month, likely shoppers who have bought before but not this month, so their account pages failed.
Account page requests could keep failing with ZeroDivisionError while monthly-spend-feature evaluates on, and switching the flag off might again leave some minutes evaluating on.
Shoppers' account pages failed to load
After it, the service still logged minutes in which evaluations returned on ({Gce95.5}), with the ZeroDivisionError in the same minutes ({G5309.4}).
Shoppers' account page requests failed, and the service logged a raised account page error rate.
Those requests failed with ZeroDivisionError raised at src/io_shop/spend_summary.py:47. This error first appears in the logs at the onset and not in the earlier minutes read.

The failing code ran because admin switched monthly-spend-feature on at {P1.1}. From that minute most flag evaluations returned on. After the flag was switched off at {P2.1}, the error was logged only in the minutes when evaluations still returned on.
When the flag is on, the code divides by the number of the shopper's purchases in the current month and does not handle the case where there are none.
Before the flag was switched on in production, no check was seen that served the account page with monthly-spend-feature on for a shopper who has bought before but not this month.
From its first minute, the flag returned on for most evaluations. No smaller staged step was seen.
